answer: Admission auction: each epoch 100 identity slots go on sale; only winners pass the velvet rope. A bid anchors an identity to a real price: the winner locks 60 coins, refunded after 20 honest epochs; a fake that never works forfeits it. The price shifts like a dune, so bulk buyers bid against themselves. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 coins against a 30,000 pool, a guaranteed loss. An honest agent pays once and keeps a full share.
